title: Valuation Actuary Note: Rates Applied When a Guarantee Period Ends During a Death Benefit Valuation, Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
On an Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contract, a guarantee period can end inside the period for which death benefit valuation interest is worked. This note sets the rates applied to the days of that period.

## Rule

- Where a guarantee period ended within the valuation period and the valuation date falls within the tier's renewal window days after the renewal date, the death benefit valuation interest is worked **in two parts multiplied together**: the days up to the renewal date at the expiring rate, which is the rate of the most recent interest credit, and the days from the renewal date at the current guaranteed rate.
- Where a guarantee period ended within the valuation period, the owner died before the renewal date, and the valuation date falls later than the tier's renewal window days after the renewal date, **every day is worked at the expiring rate**.
- Otherwise every day is worked at the current guaranteed rate.

"Two parts multiplied together" means that one plus the expiring rate, raised to the power of the days up to the renewal date over 365, is multiplied by one plus the current guaranteed rate, raised to the power of the days from the renewal date over 365; the interest is the contract value times that product less one, rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Reading the records

- *Renewal date:* the day the current guarantee period began, shown on the contract record as the start date of its surrender charge schedule.
- *A guarantee period ended within the valuation period:* the renewal date falls after the date of the most recent interest credit and before the valuation date.
- *Expiring rate:* the rate shown on the most recent interest credit entry. *Current guaranteed rate:* the guaranteed rate on the contract record.

| Tier | Renewal window days |
|---|---|
| Ashgrove Flexible Premium Deferred Annuity | 0 (no renewal window) |
| Ashgrove SecureRate 3, 5, 6, 7 and 10 | 30 |

## Worked cases (hypothetical SecureRate contract: most recent interest credit 1 February 2026 at 4.50%, renewal date 1 April 2026 at 5.25%, contract value $150000.00)

| Valuation date | Owner's death | Days before / after the renewal date | Rates |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20 April 2026 | 25 March 2026 | 59 / 19 | Two parts: 59 days at 4.50%, 19 days at 5.25% — interest $1473.99 |
| 15 May 2026 | 25 March 2026 | 59 / 44 | 44 is later than 30 and the death preceded the renewal: all 103 days at 4.50% |
| 15 May 2026 | 5 April 2026 | 59 / 44 | The death followed the renewal: all 103 days at 5.25% |
